$description: iOS-only PostScript-name font tokens. SwiftUI's Font.custom(name:) needs a font's actual PostScript name (the string embedded in the font binary's 'name' table, ID 6) — NOT a CSS family name. font.* in type.json holds CSS family-name stacks (correct for web, WRONG for Font.custom). This file is the separate iOS-only counterpart; web's family-name value is untouched. Every value here is verified against its bundled .ttf's embedded name table (fontTools), not guessed. Plus Jakarta Sans is bundled as separate static per-weight files (Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold/ExtraBold) — scoped to exactly the weights curio-capture-ios's Font.brand(weight:) call sites actually request (an earlier variable-font attempt had no individually-addressable PostScript name per weight; see CHANGELOG.md v3.0.0/v3.1.0 for the history). IBM Plex Mono ships Regular + Medium only — the only weights curio-capture-ios's Font.brandMono(weight:) requests.

display.$description: Brand-display face, iOS, Regular weight. Unused by curio-capture-ios today (kept for parity with product/evidence, same as the pre-existing fontDisplay it replaces) — add weight variants here if/when a real call site needs them, not speculatively.

productSemiBold.$description: UI/body/figures face, iOS, SemiBold weight — the most-used weight override in curio-capture-ios (59 call sites).

productExtraBold.$description: UI/body/figures face, iOS, ExtraBold weight — maps to SwiftUI's Font.Weight.heavy (both are the 800 weight class).

evidence.$description: Evidence/identifier face (card no., cert, SKU), iOS Regular weight.
